title: Cyberattack at Moscone Center Puts Event Data Security in the Spotlight
summary: Legends Global confirms Moscone Center experienced a cybersecurity incident but hasn’t said whether data was stolen. For planners, it raises a bigger question: How much sensitive event data are venues holding and for how long?

title: Why One Supplier Decided to Create a Free Resource Hub for Planners
summary: Planners still rely on word of mouth to find vendors they can trust. The founder of Silicon Valley Speakers is working to build an online network to offer more options.

title: How Meeting Planners Can Avoid Falling for Sophisticated Scams
summary: The traits that make planners good at their jobs – responsiveness and an ability to meet tight deadlines – are exactly what scammers are exploiting.

title: What 20 Years of Building Events Taught Me About Their Real Value
summary: People attend business events looking for ideas, relationships, customers and opportunities. After nearly 20 years of building events, I have come to believe that their highest value is more personal: changing how people feel about the work they are returning to.

title: Steal This Idea: An Empty Chair on Your Next Stage
summary: Planners keep trying to figure out how to make meetings more engaging. Handing five minutes to an attendee for an unscripted chat is a simple way show the room its views belong in the program, not just in the Q&A.

title: Career Advice From an Event Manager Who Made It to the C-Level
summary: Event managers already have the business savvy and problem-solving skills they need to move up, said this chief strategy officer. The key is to realize that.

title: U.S. Politics Are Costing Cities Meetings They Won't Host Until 2031
summary: Politics can shift in one election cycle. A 2031 contract can't. Cities losing bids over U.S. policy now will pay for it long after the politics change.

title: What Autonomous AI Means for Event Planning
summary: Planners have mostly faced AI adoption as binary — use it or wait. Joshi argued that the real decision is where on the autonomy spectrum should start.

title: How Continuity Drives Creativity
summary: The planner's role is evaluated on outcomes, and those still spending their time on sourcing cycles are competing on the wrong metric.

title: What Austin and SXSW Learned So Far
summary: With Austin's convention center closed, SXSW was pushed toward a distributed format. Other cities can learn from its lessons.
